_meta.description: Complete feedback taxonomy for Pidilite User Feedback AI Pipeline

taxonomy.feedback_sub_tag: If comp name mentioned, state name. If PIL product is stated, also mention name
taxonomy.description: Comparison of Pidilite product and product from competition brands. Product quality includes ease of application, drying time, shelf life, pot life, viscocity, anti-bubble technology, variance in grip, intensity of grab.

taxonomy.feedback_sub_tag: If comp name mentioned, state name. If PIL product is stated, also mention name
taxonomy.description: Comparison of pidilite scheme with competition company scheme. Includes, products with dealer trip schemes, user token value/schemes, user gift, competition user application, spot redemption, dealer gifts, points value offered by competition, user trip schemes.

taxonomy.feedback_sub_tag: If comp company name mentioned, state name. If PIL mentioned, also mention PIL
taxonomy.description: Activities that competition companies conduct for users. This includes meetings in big hotels, contractor meetings in small towns, site activities, festival celebrations, birthday celebration, user family engagement programs, carnivals, and digital engagements as well.

taxonomy.feedback_sub_tag: If comp APP mentioned, state name. If PIL APP is stated, also mention name
taxonomy.description: Comparison of Pidilite contractor app and competition - Which apps competition is using for contractors, points for different pack sizes, bonus points, redemption options, gift options, online delivery of gifts, ease of redemption, new product information,product application videos, product catalogues.

taxonomy.feedback_tag: Product In Pack quality / packaging / application complaints
taxonomy.feedback_sub_tag: If comp name mentioned, state name. If PIL product is stated, also mention name
taxonomy.description: Product Packaging - Leakage issues, information on packaging, token inside, token scanning, ease of opening and closing pack, longevity of product provided by packaging. Application includes ease of applying product on substrate - whether it be laminate, or any other surface. Single vs. multi-direction application, requirement of masking tape, application on plywood vs. Laminate. Application related complaints - bubble formation, uneven surface, rubbery glue, odd smell, difficulty in adhesion.

taxonomy.feedback_sub_tag: If comp name mentioned, state name. If PIL product is stated, also mention name
taxonomy.description: Improvements can include areas such as strength of product, new avenues of application, longevity of product, shelf life, pot life

taxonomy.feedback_sub_tag: If comp name mentioned, state name. If PIL product is stated, also mention name
taxonomy.description: Improvements can include ease of storage, transportation, uniqueness, easy identification, PIL branding, token identification, scanning options, clarity in manufacturing and expiry dates.

Credit days competition offers to dealers - can be 3,4,6 months. High credit days is sometimes a reason for dealer to purchase competition. PIL provides 30 days across most of its products.

Delay in stock from distributor or company can lead to dealer disgruntlement. Stock unavailability is also a concern for dealers. When dealer faces stock issue, dealer will resort to wholesale market for urgent requirements.

Common dealer disgrutlement issues - stock issues, pending scheme settlements, employees not visiting, damaged stock received, disgruntement with distributor, lack of user meets for dealer's key users, no gifts from company.
